body:
incident-bot: CRITICAL: GPU pool us-west-2-gpu-pool-9 crossing 94% utilization at 2025-07-15T04:12:01Z. Autoscaler requests failing with quota_rejected. Paging on-call.

alex: jumped in. I'm seeing the /v21.3/generate endpoints queueing. p95->p99 spike.

priya: qlen went from ~20 to ~260 in ~9m. KV index write rate skyrocketed. KV entry sizes larger than expected.

jesse: any deploys in the timeframe? we had a model push earlier tonight.

marta: yes — v21.3 promoted to prod at 03:45 UTC. it bumped the default context to 18k and enabled "prefill.kv.experimental" to reduce cold latency.

samir: that matches telemetry: prefill wave started at rollout and produced a sustained write load to kv-store. combined with bigger contexts, per-request KV footprint increased ~3x.

alex: autoscaler shows: scale attempts made but cloud API returned quota_exceeded. no new instances could be provisioned.

infra-bot: Autoscaler excerpts:
```
2025-07-15T04:08:12Z scale_request pool=us-west-2-gpu-pool-9 desired=68 current=22 reason=queue_pressure
2025-07-15T04:09:05Z cloud_api -> 403 QuotaExceeded for account redwood-prod
2025-07-15T04:10:30Z scale_backoff until 04:13:30Z
```

priya: customer impact: elevated tail latency and 429s. CS reported two paying customers and several sandbox orgs. I can coordinate customer comms.

sara-support: on it. draft message?

priya: short note: "We're seeing resource pressure in us-west-2 caused by a model rollout change. We're applying mitigations now and will update in 15 minutes." send?

sara-support: sending. :email:

jesse: mitigation options listed: fast rollback (v21.3->v21.2), flip prefill off, surgical throttles for non-prod tiers, or activate reserved burst capacity. prefer non-evicting first.

marta: agreed. flipping the prefill flag is lowest-risk. flag name: prefill.kv.experimental. will set false for prod region.

marta: command executed:
```
redwoodctl feature toggle --model v21.3 --region us-west-2 prefill.kv.experimental=false
```

infra-bot: feature toggle acknowledged. propagation expected <45s.

samir: watching metrics: queue 260 -> 200 -> 140 -> 70 over ~10m. KV write throughput falling.

alex: also enabling admission control to protect paying customers: throttle sandbox & free tiers to 3 rps. command:
```
redwoodctl admission set --region us-west-2 --tier sandbox --rps 3
```

infra-bot: admission control applied.

priya: CS update sent: included mitigation details and ETA for next update in 30m. initial replies indicate two customers saw improved behavior.

infra: opened cloud quota support: case CLD-1011223 at 04:22 UTC requesting temporary increase and explanation for rejection.

infra: also enabled local pool burst mode to provision reserved instances as a stopgap. command:
```
infractl pool update us-west-2-gpu-pool-9 --enable-burst=true
```

infra-bot: burst provisioning started; expected to be ready in ~3m.

alex: queue now 38 and falling. p99 generation latency dropped from 7.0s -> 1.9s. error rate down to 1.2%.

marta: recommended next steps: keep prefill disabled for v21.3 in prod for at least 60m. run a controlled canary of prefill with a smaller context window and ramp slowly.

jesse: action items for postmortem:
- Why did autoscaler not surface quota rejections earlier? add alert when scale attempts are rejected for >2 attempts.
- Add gating to rollout process for any model that increases default context or toggles prefill; require scaled staging tests with realistic prefill traffic.
- Consider automatic soft-rollbacks if scale requests blocked for >X minutes and queue continues to grow.

marta: handing over to night-oncall. Handoff notes:
- prefill.kv.experimental disabled for v21.3 in us-west-2
- burst capacity active for us-west-2-gpu-pool-9
- admission throttles set for sandbox tiers (3 rps)
- cloud case CLD-1011223 opened for quota bump
- alert thresholds: qlen > 100 or error_rate > 5% -> page

marta: pinning traffic for sensitive tenants to v21.2 to reduce warmup risk:
```
redwoodctl route bind --customer enterprise-omega --model v21.2 --region us-west-2
```

infra-bot: routing change applied.

priya: monitoring shows qlen ~22, p99 1.5s, errors 0.7%. stabilization looks good.

sara-support: CS will prepare a follow-up with impacted customers once we have root cause and remediation timeline.

samir: note for postmortem artifacts: attach KV write histograms, per-request KV size distribution, and e2e load test scripts that replicate prefill behavior.

jesse: also include timeline of quota rejection -> mitigation and measure MTTR. propose adding a dashboard panel showing outstanding scale requests and cloud response codes.

night-oncall: acknowledged handoff. Will escalate if qlen > 100 or errors > 5% overnight.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied; incident moved to MONITORING. Please add notes to incident tracker: https://redwood.incidents/3329980011

marta: creating postmortem ticket and tagging eng-ml, eng-runtime, infra, and support. preliminary root cause: model v21.3 increased default context and enabled KV prefill by default; combined effect created a large warmup write wave which autoscaler could not absorb due to cloud quota limits, leading to queueing and throttles.

participants: incident-bot, alex, priya, jesse, marta, samir, infra-bot, infra, sara-support, night-oncall
